name: Corpse Bride AI
blurb: One photo in: you become a blue-skinned undead bride in a torn veil and dance under the full moon, in a 12-second vertical clip.

prompts.label: Corpse Bride AI â plain face to bride in one flick
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep the woman exactly as photographed, same face, hair colour and build, so she is clearly the same person. Vertical 9:16, one continuous shot, phone video against a plain grey wall. (1) For the first two seconds she is exactly as in the photo, talking casually to the camera. (2) She flicks her wrist across the lens and, in one cut, she is an undead bride: pale blue-grey skin, a dark stitched scar across her brow, smoky grey eyes, dark red lips, her hair set in vintage pin curls, a torn lace veil and a stained, ripped white wedding dress. (3) She stares into the lens, slowly runs her hand down her neck and tilts her head to the beat, lip-syncing with a cold little smile. Her face stays the same person throughout. Audio: an original eerie pop beat with a music-box melody, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no cartoon characters.

(3) To the beat she starts a jerky undead-bride dance: shoulders twitching, arms swinging stiffly, a slow sway, a shuffle step toward the camera and a final lurch into the lens. Her face stays the same person throughout. Audio: an original spooky electro-swing beat, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no cartoon characters.

prompts.label: Corpse Bride AI â the ghost bride in the misty forest
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep the woman exactly as photographed, same face, dark hair and build, so she is clearly the same person. Vertical 9:16, one continuous shot, cinematic, a misty pine forest at dawn with white smoke drifting between the trees, desaturated colours. (1) Far away between the trees, a figure in a long white wedding gown and veil stands in the fog. (2) She glides closer: pale blue-grey skin, heavy black eye shadows and black lips, the veil over her hair, a lace gown trailing on the forest floor. (3) She raises her arms and turns slowly in the smoke, then stops in a close-up and stares straight through the lens. Her face stays the same person throughout.
